query_text: Where can I buy the latest iPhone?

action.query: Apple latest iPhone buy official iPhone 2026
queries: Apple latest iPhone buy official iPhone 2026

annotations.title: Shop Apple iPhones: iPhone 17 Pro, Pro Max, 17e & Air​

content.text:
You can buy the latest iPhone from:

- **Apple Store / Apple.com** — best for unlocked models, trade-in, AppleCare+, and setup help. Apple’s current newest lineup includes **iPhone 17 / 17 Pro / 17 Pro Max / iPhone Air**, plus the newer entry-level **iPhone 17e** released in 2026. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_iPhone_models?utm_source=openai))  
- **Major U.S. carriers** — **AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile** often have the best trade-in or installment deals. AT&T, for example, lists current Apple iPhone 17-family models. ([att.com](https://www.att.com/buy/phones/browse/apple/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Retailers** — **Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Target, Amazon** may carry unlocked or carrier-activated iPhones, sometimes with gift-card or activation promos.

**Quick recommendation:**  
If you want the safest/easiest purchase, buy directly from **Apple**. If you’re willing to finance or trade in through a carrier, check **AT&T/Verizon/T-Mobile** for better promo pricing.
